acceptanceCriteria: replace mode accepts a record whose changes are cell values only and re-emits them with predecessor digests and a CHANGES.md section
a test re-emits a cell-only change; one mutation restoring the early refusal fails it
body: Residual from the V1-1437 lane (PR #941, head 23b734bd5, Codex round 1, medium). tools/cem-stable-regen/replace.go (around line 198) refuses 'no case value changes' before it reads --cell-values. Expected: a recorded correction that changes only envelope cells (no matching case) can be re-emitted under CEM-V1-091's recorded re-emission. Actual: replace mode refuses it. Fails closed; the PR #941 re-emission was unaffected.
title: cem-stable-regen --replace refuses a cell-only re-emission before reading --cell-values
